author: grandami499
quote:
GTA 6 is a complete joke. After years of hype, Rockstar delivers a buggy, broken mess that crashes every ten minutes and still somehow manages to feel empty.
There’s almost no real freedom of choice — every “decision” is an illusion that leads to the same scripted outcome. The whole thing plays like a woke cuck simulator where the player is constantly railroaded into progressive talking points instead of being allowed to actually cause chaos.
Mediocre map, recycled missions, forced narrative, and zero soul. This isn’t Grand Theft Auto. It’s a $70 lecture with bad performance. Absolute garbage.
